detail: Contextberg is a local work-memory application for macOS and Windows. It captures screen, input, browser and supported agent activity, organizes that history into activity, daily and long-term memory, and exposes context to MCP-compatible agents. Users can choose a local model or a hosted model route; that choice changes whether required context leaves the device.
limitations: Contextberg records screens, inputs, browser activity and agent conversations, so users must be comfortable collecting sensitive work context.
Only a local model keeps the entire processing flow local; the official site says required context is sent when another model route is selected.
The Free plan lists a basic Gemini model and 180-day data retention; unlimited retention is a paid Lite feature.
notIdealFor: People who do not want screen, input or browser activity recorded
Teams that require every inference route to remain fully local
pricingSnapshot: Free: $0 forever; Lite: $8/month; Pro: coming soon. Verified 2026-08-31 on the official pricing page.
summary: Contextberg records local work context and exposes useful screen, browser and agent history to MCP-compatible coding agents.
title: Contextberg

decisionReason: The official site and repository verify scope, supported agents, alpha maturity and license. The candidate can enter draft review but is not automatically publishable.
detail: Re_gent is an open-source local-first CLI that records AI coding-agent activity alongside project changes. Its log, blame and show workflows connect code changes to the agent session and prompt that produced them. The current Public Alpha supports Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, while several other coding assistants remain roadmap items.
limitations: The product is explicitly labeled Public Alpha, so workflows and storage semantics may still change.
The official site currently lists Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode; Cursor, Cline, Continue and Aider are planned rather than supported.
Re_gent complements Git and focuses on agent activity; it is not a replacement for repository version control.
notIdealFor: Teams that require a stable production release
Users whose primary coding agent is not currently supported
pricingSnapshot: Free forever under the Apache-2.0 license. Verified 2026-08-31 on the official site and repository.
summary: Re_gent is a local-first version-control layer for AI coding-agent activity, linking file changes to prompts and captured sessions.
title: Re_gent

detail: Invenio is a macOS menu-bar application that indexes video and photo libraries locally and supports natural-language visual search, OCR and spoken-word search. It can index internal folders, external drives and RAID arrays, then lets editors drag matching clips into common NLE timelines. The application requires an Apple Silicon Mac and does not support Intel Macs.
limitations: Invenio requires macOS on Apple Silicon; Intel Macs and non-Mac platforms are not supported.
Speech transcript search is not included in the Free plan and requires Pro or Lifetime access.
Local indexing uses the device's compute and storage resources, so first-time processing effort depends on the size of the media library.
notIdealFor: Windows, Linux or Intel Mac users
Users who need cloud-shared team libraries rather than local media search
pricingSnapshot: Free: $0; Pro: $6.99/month or $49.99/year; Lifetime: $99.99. Verified 2026-08-31 on the official homepage.
summary: Invenio provides local natural-language, visual and transcript search across video and photo libraries on a Mac without cloud uploads.
title: Invenio

decisionReason: Official product, pricing and company pages verify the workflow and expose an important pricing inconsistency. The candidate can enter draft review with that caveat visible.
detail: Thinnest AI is an India-focused BYOK platform for building voice and chat agents with telephony, workflow tools, knowledge bases and multilingual speech. Its dedicated pricing page lists a platform fee plus provider pass-through costs, while enterprise options add private-cloud or on-premise deployment and compliance review. Official pages currently disagree between ₹2 and ₹1.5 per minute.
limitations: The dedicated pricing page lists ₹2/minute, but the homepage and About page still state ₹1.5/minute; buyers should confirm the live rate before purchase.
The platform fee is not the complete cost: LLM provider tokens pass through separately, and Indian customers also pay 18% GST.
Compliance statements are vendor claims; regulated teams still need their own legal, security and deployment review.
notIdealFor: Teams that require one all-inclusive per-minute price
Buyers who need independently certified compliance without additional review
pricingSnapshot: Pricing page: Trial includes 50 voice minutes and 200 chat messages; PAYG is ₹2/min plus provider pass-through; Enterprise is custom with a stated ₹1.75/min floor at 100k+ minutes. Homepage/About still show ₹1.5/min. Verified 2026-08-31.
summary: Thinnest AI is a BYOK voice and chat agent platform focused on Indian languages, telephony workflows and INR-based platform pricing.
title: Thinnest AI

detail: Motion by Mosaic is an AI motion-design agent for launch videos, product demos, explainers, logo animation and social ads. It researches a product or brand, plans a storyboard, builds scenes with voiceover, music and captions, and keeps generated elements editable. The product is available through its web app, while API and MCP workflows require an authenticated account and available Motion credits.
limitations: Credit usage is variable: the official guide estimates 200 credits for roughly 1-2 videos, while longer videos, premium models, voiceover and follow-up edits can consume more.
API jobs require available account credits and can fail with an insufficient-credits response; credit purchases and auto top-ups are managed outside the public API.
Brand research and generated scenes still need human review for factual accuracy, source rights and creative direction, even though individual elements remain editable.

rationale.en: Motion addresses a clear production problem by turning a brief or product URL into a researched storyboard and editable motion-design project. An independent user completed a video in under five minutes and confirmed the value of element-level editing, but also reported high credit consumption and limited fine-grained animation control. Product Hunt shows meaningful launch interest, yet still has no formal reviews, while two recent hands-on comparisons reached the research step but could not evaluate output without buying credits. Mosaic has operated since 2024, is active in YC W25 and provides a credible durability signal, but that company-level evidence does not prove sustained adoption of the four-month-old Motion product. Motion therefore remains an emerging candidate until repeat usage, customer adoption or a broader body of completed independent tests is available.
rationale.zh: Motion 通过把 brief 或产品网址转化为经过研究的分镜和可编辑 motion-design 项目，解决了明确的视频生产问题。一名独立用户在五分钟内完成了视频，并验证了元素级编辑的价值，但同时记录了 credits 消耗高和精细动画控制有限的问题。Product Hunt 有一定发布热度，却仍没有正式 review；另外两次近期实测只到达研究阶段，未付费便无法评价最终输出。Mosaic 自 2024 年运营、处于 YC W25 active 状态，能够提供持续性信号，但公司层面的证据不能代替上线约四个月的 Motion 自身采用证据。因此 Motion 暂定为 Emerging，需等待重复使用、客户采用或更多完成生成的独立测试后再决定发布。

notIdealFor: Teams that require a fixed per-video cost before generation
Editors who need a traditional frame-accurate timeline as the primary workflow
pricingSnapshot: Credits cost $5 for 200. The official guide estimates about 1-2 videos per 200 credits and about 18-20 videos per 5,000 credits; actual usage varies with duration, model, voiceover and follow-up edits. Verified 2026-09-01.
summary: Motion is a video agent that researches and storyboards from prompts and references, then keeps generated scenes editable at the element level.
title: Motion

decisionReason: The official product, pricing and terms pages verify the voice-agent workflow, paid tiers, country allocation and user compliance duties. Conflicting free-quota language and variable credit consumption remain explicit caveats.
detail: PollyReach gives AI agents dedicated phone numbers for inbound and outbound voice workflows such as customer support, appointment booking, lead qualification and dispatch. The official site advertises multilingual calling across more than 50 countries, while paid plans limit how many agents and phone-number countries an account can configure. Users remain responsible for consent, AI disclosure, do-not-call checks, calling hours and call records.
limitations: The homepage says accounts start with a monthly free quota, while another official landing page advertises 200 free credits per week; buyers should verify the live allowance in the product.

The terms say credit usage varies by request, service, model tier and system conditions, and do not guarantee a fixed amount of work per credit; the public pricing page does not publish a credit-to-minute conversion or overage rate.

The homepage claims 50+ countries, but plans limit configured number countries: Star includes a default US number, Pro supports 2 countries and Max 5; an exact supported-country list is not published on the reviewed pages.
Users are responsible for call consent, AI disclosure, DNC screening, local calling-hour limits and record keeping; platform access does not replace telecommunications compliance review.
notIdealFor: Teams that require a deterministic per-minute or per-call cost
Unconsented consumer cold calling or high-risk regulated calling workflows
pricingSnapshot: Start free without a card. Monthly: Star $20 for 2,000 credits, Pro $40 for 4,000, Max $100 for 10,000. Yearly billing displays $17/$34/$85 monthly equivalents. Free-quota frequency and credit-to-minute conversion remain unclear. Verified 2026-09-01.
summary: PollyReach gives AI agents dedicated phone numbers and calling workflows for reservations, support, scheduling and other business interactions.
title: PollyReach
